findings.title: Insufficient authorization check in resolve() allows reporter to resolve tickets
findings.explanation: The resolve method permits the ticket reporter to resolve a ticket, contrary to the acceptance criteria that only the assignee or an administrator may resolve, potentially allowing unauthorized users to close tickets. Also reported by compliance, defects as logic_defect: The resolve method allows the ticket reporter to resolve the ticket and does not consider administrators, contrary to the acceptance criteria which require only the assignee or an administrator to be able to resolve. This can let unauthorized users close tickets. Also reported by compliance as requirement_mismatch: The ticket requires that only the assignee or an administrator can resolve a ticke…

criteria.text: Resolving follows the normal workflow (a ticket must be in progress first).
criteria.explanation: Resolving uses the workflow `transition` function, which enforces the normal status progression (a ticket must be IN_PROGRESS before it can be RESOLVED). The test suite verifies that calling resolve on a ticket not in progress raises InvalidTransition.
